utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do we have extra cables and power supplies for the repair drive? I was going to check the inventory.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! I keep mixing up the days—sorry. Let me check my garage; I think I have some spare cables.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, let me know what you find. I'll check the bin in my garage too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Hana, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? They're fixing broken stuff from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I'm helping coordinate the volunteers, so I'll be there all day.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's awesome, Hana! Let me know if you need an extra pair of hands—I'm free that day.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We really should check the online inventory to see if they have the right parts. I'm worried about that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You really think the online inventory will be accurate? I'd rather hear it from someone who's actually organizing this thing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I get that, but the inventory list is updated by the organizers. If it's wrong, we can call them to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Dane, just confirming we're still on for Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that's what I heard too, but I'm still catching up on the details—sorry I'm late.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem, Dane. Just wanted to double-check since I'm mapping out the weekend. See you Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, just a heads up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? That's a change. Do you know the new start time and if the sign-up is still the same?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Rosa mentioned 10 AM works, so I think that's the new time. Not sure about the sign-up though.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! I think the repair drive might have moved to Sunday, but let me check with Hana to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Okay, let me know what you find out. I'm free on Sunday too if that's the case.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll reach out to Hana now and let you know as soon as I hear back!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah! Yeah, I'm going. It starts at 9 AM sharp at the community center. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, 9 AM it is. I'll be there—hopefully I remember this time!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Don't worry, I'll send you a reminder just in case! See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, you going to the repair drive Saturday morning at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Does that time work for you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Sunday works great for me. Let's meet up to update the flyers later today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Today works too! What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'll be there! I've been reminding everyone I can. Can't wait to see you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, it's going to be so much fun! I'm planning to volunteer all day, so we'll hang out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, are you going to the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I think so. Hana said she'd add my broken chair to the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's good to hear. I'm still waiting on the exact times from the organizers, but I'll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a community repair drive this Saturday morning at the community center. I don't have the exact time yet, but I'll let you know when I find out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I thought I heard something about it being moved to Sunday? I'll have to check with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I hadn't heard that. I was planning on Saturday. I'll check with the organizers too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center? They're fixing broken stuff for free!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it got moved to Sunday now, actually. I'm picking up flyers for it tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday! Are you sure? I was planning to volunteer all day Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the repair drive is Saturday morning at the center. I've got a broken chair I'm hoping they can fix.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Alright, Saturday at the center — let me double-check my map to make sure I've got the right day.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, Saturday morning. I think it starts at 9.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey, just a heads-up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, same time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, it's Sunday now? I thought Pia confirmed it was Saturday at 10 AM. Can you double-check that?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I double-checked with the organizers—it's definitely Sunday now. Same time, just a different day. We're meeting tomorrow at 10 AM to update the flyers if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm helping organize it! You should come, it's at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great! I've been telling people about it too. Do you need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning at the center, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That's what I heard too, but I'm not sure about the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it's in the morning, maybe 10? Or we could ask Mara or Faye.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hello! I'm so glad you're here. Are we talking about the repair drive on Saturday? I've got a toaster that's been giving me trouble.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM at the community center! Bring that toaster along—I'm sure someone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, 9 AM at the community center. I'll make sure to bring that toaster. Thanks for the reminder!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive this Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Actually, Cleo, I think it's this Saturday, not Sunday. I'm meeting Rosa tomorrow morning to go over the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it was changed to Sunday, Gus! Rosa told me. I have the updated flyers if you want to grab some.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rey, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I'm not the organizer—just helping spread the word. I'm still waiting on the exact time, but it's Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm actually helping Leo sort donations on Saturday, so I'll be there too. Let me know if you need any extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Sunday at 10 AM works perfectly for me. Can you confirm with Hana, Jules?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I'll confirm with Hana and Jules.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Leo. Let me know once you hear back from them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster, but I'm still waiting on the times from the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I'll be there. The drive runs from 9 AM to 3 PM on Saturday. I can help with your toaster if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh great, thanks for the times! I'll let you know if I need help with the toaster.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, 9 AM Saturday at the community center. But you're worried about parts?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You bet I'm worried. I've seen too many of these things turn into a wild goose chase.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Well, maybe I can ask around if anyone has spare parts lying around.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, let's see what we've got in there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Alright, let's open it up and see what's inside.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let's see if we have those cables and power supplies.
